sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 4 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：AVGO、MU、MRVL、HOOD、SPCX。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今天是教科书般的板块轮动撕裂的一天。道琼斯指数收盘上涨1.08%，标普500指数收盘为-0.14%，纳斯达克指数收盘为-0.76%——这些指数表面上平静，但内心却出现了资金的剧烈转移：科技/半导体股受到重创，而蓝筹股和防御性股票介入支撑道琼斯指数。

今日核心活动：

  • AVGO earnings miss drags down Nasdaq: Down 13% pre-market, ending the day around -15%. The issue wasn't the numbers themselves (EPS $2.44 vs. expected $2.40, AI revenue doubled to $10.8B), but rather CEO Hock Tan not raising the full-year $100B AI chip sales target, and Q3 AI guidance of $16B falling short of the $17.2B expectation. It was a case of "expectations were too high and not met," rather than a fundamental collapse—major investment banks immediately raised their price targets.
  • MU recovers after dipping below $1000: Dropped to near $975 intraday, then pulled back above $1000. Micron has surpassed a $1 trillion market cap (approx. $1.22T, 12th largest globally), up nearly 1000% over the past year, with 2026 HBM capacity completely sold out. Additional headwinds today included SK Hynix planning a US listing + CEO selling shares.
  • MRVL continues its legendary run: Continued to rise following Jensen Huang's endorsement as the "next trillion-dollar company," gaining 10% in a single hour intraday, up $25 in 55 minutes; the community has entered a state of pure mania.
  • Oil continues to slide: Brent ~$96.25 (-1.6%) due to the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire + reports that Trump is unwilling to restart a war with Iran. Bessent stated the Iran conflict "has been halted."
  • PDT rule officially abolished today: Retail day trading restrictions lifted, triggering an over-trading frenzy.
  • Blackstone limits redemptions for BCRED ($79B private credit fund) (capped at 5%, as Q2 redemption requests reached 10%), following Partners Group—cracks in private credit liquidity are emerging, though largely ignored by the community.

情绪基调：极度贪婪，近乎宗教的乐观情绪。早间“AI泡沫破灭/血红”的恐慌被两小时内的V型复苏所吞噬，“bers fuk Again”充斥着饲料。然而，必须注意一个关键的分歧：虽然 WSB 欢呼“我们回来了”，但实际指数持平或略有下降——他们庆祝的“绿色”主要来自个股（MRVL/RDDT/道指成分股）和“从早间低点反弹”，而不是广泛的市场反弹。 VIX只有15左右，被社区戏称为“今天唯一的血红色东西”。我估计恐惧/贪婪为 78/100（极度贪婪），但表面之下越来越多的不安，诸如“地毯拉力即将到来”和“这感觉空洞”之类的评论。
